title: Atik Mustafa Pasha Mosque
geometryBasis: The named current outline measures 18.80 m by 15.54 m. The architectural inventory records a 17.5 m by 15 m original church body, three polygonal apses and a tower at the southwest corner.
sectionBasis: Van Millingen describes triple arcade bays, an upper tripartite light and three externally faceted apses. Eyice and Istanbul’s religious-affairs inventory record the timber porch and later single-balcony stone minaret with a stone cap. Qualla’s exact 2025 interior photograph shows the uninterrupted dome bowl and taller side windows of the restored building.
limitations: The 2025 published interior image provides dome and window evidence. Exterior heights, stone and brick color, chapel recesses and porch framing are estimated from surveyed descriptions and the named map envelope.
This model represents the standing mosque after the 2024 restoration. Painted interior surfaces, interior tomb furnishings and the separately addressed street fountain are outside scope.
